spec: Foundry for Good Pitch Forum: authoritative application form specification. 33 fields, 4 steps, 5 eligibility gates.

behaviour_contract.steps: Four steps. Next and Back navigate. Submit only on the last step.
behaviour_contract.gates: An option marked gate:true ends the application and shows the gate_card whose number matches gate_card. Steps 2 to 4 and the submit button hide. A 'Go back and change an answer' button restores the form.
behaviour_contract.show_if: field:value. The field is hidden until that option is selected, and is required only while visible.
behaviour_contract.disabled_by: Named checkbox, when ticked, disables and clears this field and makes it not required.
behaviour_contract.char_counter: Live character counter shown as used/limit. Add a 'near' state at 90 percent of the limit.
behaviour_contract.derived: A live read-only line computed from this field and its paired current-value field. revenue pairs revenue_last_12 with revenue_prior_12; customers pairs customers_now with customers_prior_12.
behaviour_contract.invalid_state: A failing control or fieldset carries an 'invalid' state.
behaviour_contract.hidden_fields: Seven hidden attribution inputs, populated from the URL and referrer.

steps.title: Eligibility
steps.intro: Five questions. No typing. If you answer yes to all five, the application opens.

steps.title: The business
steps.intro: The panel reads every application side by side. Most of this is a number or a click.

steps.title: The ask
steps.intro: Four questions and two boxes to check. Three of the four are written answers.

gate_cards.heading: This application is for for-profit companies.
gate_cards.body: You told us your organization is a nonprofit, so the Pitch Forum is not the right room. Foundry for Good invests in the businesses that sell to nonprofits, schools, and associations.
gate_cards.reopen_button: Go back and change an answer

gate_cards.heading: The Pitch Forum is for companies whose customers are nonprofits, schools, associations, and faith-based organizations.
gate_cards.body: The panel's operating experience is in that market. If you do not sell into it, there is nothing here they can help you with.
gate_cards.reopen_button: Go back and change an answer

gate_cards.heading: The panel invests in companies with a proven product and real customers.
gate_cards.body: Come back when you are selling.
gate_cards.reopen_button: Go back and change an answer

gate_cards.heading: Panel members buy minority stakes of $25K to $100K each.
gate_cards.body: If you are not selling equity, there is nothing for this room to do. Tell us when that changes.
gate_cards.reopen_button: Go back and change an answer

gate_cards.heading: The forum runs quarterly.
gate_cards.body: Leave your work email and we will write when applications open for the next one.
gate_cards.reopen_button: Go back and change an answer

fields.name: is_for_profit
fields.label: Is your company a for-profit business?
fields.micro: Foundry for Good invests in businesses that sell to nonprofits, schools, and associations. We do not invest in nonprofits.

fields.name: sells_to_sector
fields.label: Do you sell your product or service to nonprofits, schools, associations, or faith-based organizations?
fields.micro: You do not have to sell only into this sector. You do have to sell into it today.

fields.name: has_paying_customers
fields.label: Do you have paying customers using your product today?
fields.micro: Paying customers, not pilots and not letters of intent.

fields.name: open_to_minority_stake
fields.label: Are you open to selling a minority stake in your company?
fields.micro: Panel members invest $25K to $100K each. Nobody at this forum is buying your company.

fields.name: can_present_oct8
fields.label: The Pitch Forum is on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 2:00pm ET on Zoom. Can a founder present live at that time?
fields.micro: Each slot is 10 to 15 minutes: a 5 to 10 minute presentation, then questions. You get your own slot inside that window. Selected founders receive the Zoom link at least a week before the forum.

fields.name: contact_name
fields.label: Your full name

fields.name: contact_title
fields.label: Your title
fields.micro: Founders present at the forum. Tell us who will be on the Zoom.

fields.name: work_email
fields.label: Work email
fields.micro: Use your company address. The decision and the Zoom link go here.
fields.error: That address does not look complete. It should look like you@yourcompany.com.

fields.name: linkedin_url
fields.label: Your LinkedIn profile
fields.micro: The panel reads this before the forum.
fields.error: That does not look like a LinkedIn profile. It should start with linkedin.com/in/.

fields.name: company_name
fields.label: Company name

fields.name: company_website
fields.label: Company website
fields.error: Add https:// to the front of the link.

fields.name: one_liner
fields.label: In one sentence, what does your company do?
fields.micro: Name the product and name the buyer. This is the line the panel reads first.
fields.placeholder: Grant management software for community foundations.

fields.name: markets_served
fields.label: Who do you sell to? Select every market you sell into today.
fields.micro: Markets where you have paying customers today, not markets you plan to enter.

fields.name: markets_other
fields.label: Which other market?
fields.error: Name the market, or uncheck Other.

fields.name: headquarters
fields.label: Where is the business headquartered?
fields.micro: The location of your main operations, not where you are incorporated.

fields.name: first_sale_year
fields.label: What year did you book your first paying customer?

fields.name: revenue_last_12
fields.label: What was your revenue over the last 12 months?
fields.micro: Two numbers, not a growth rate. We calculate the rate.
fields.error: Add a number. Enter 0 if there was none.

fields.name: revenue_prior_12
fields.label: What was your revenue over the 12 months before that?
fields.micro: Round numbers are fine. The panel is reading the direction of travel.
fields.error: Add a number, or check the box below if you were not selling yet.

fields.name: revenue_prior_na
fields.label: We had no revenue and no customers 12 months ago

fields.name: recurring_share
fields.label: Roughly what share of that revenue is contracted or recurring?
fields.micro: Subscriptions, licenses, and retainers count. One-time projects and implementation fees do not.

options.value: None. We sell projects and one-time work.
options.text: None. We sell projects and one-time work.

fields.name: customers_now
fields.label: How many customers are paying you today?
fields.micro: At least one. A customer who pays you on any schedule counts once.

fields.name: customers_prior_12
fields.label: How many were paying you 12 months ago?
fields.error: Add a number. Enter 0 if there were none.

fields.name: customers_retained
fields.label: Of the customers you had a year ago, how many are still with you?
fields.micro: Count the customers from a year ago who are still paying you.

fields.name: headcount
fields.label: How many people work on this full time, including founders?
fields.micro: At least one, counting yourself. Count anyone working 30 hours a week or more, wherever they are based.

fields.name: capital_raised
fields.label: How much outside capital have you raised to date?

options.value: None. We are funded by revenue.
options.text: None. We are funded by revenue.

fields.name: deck_url
fields.label: Link to your deck, one-pager, or website overview
fields.micro: A link anyone on the panel can open without a download, a sign-in, or an access request. A PDF link, DocSend, or Pitch all work. If you use Google Slides, set it to anyone with the link can view before you paste it. Canva, WeTransfer, and video files are not reviewed. If you are not running a raise and do not have a deck, a link to the page on your site that best explains what you sell is fine.
fields.error: Add https:// to the front of the link.

fields.name: demo_url
fields.label: Link to a product demo, if one already exists
fields.micro: A Loom, a recorded webinar, a conference talk, anything that already exists. Do not record something new for this.
fields.error: Add https:// to the front of the link.

fields.name: raise_amount
fields.label: How much are you looking to raise in total?
fields.micro: Panel members write checks of $25K to $100K each, and more than one can come in on the same company.

options.value: We are not running a round. We are open to the right individual investors.
options.text: We are not running a round. We are open to the right individual investors.

fields.name: growth_need
fields.label: What does your business need to accelerate growth?
fields.micro: Tip: be specific. "More customers" is too broad. "Capital for two more account executives, and a renewal motion that does not depend on me" is the right altitude.

fields.name: introductions
fields.label: Name up to three introductions that would change your next 12 months.
fields.micro: Companies, channels, or job titles. One per line. The operators on this panel close introductions in this market every quarter.

fields.name: other_notes
fields.label: Anything else the panel should know?
fields.micro: If there is a number, a contract, or a risk the panel will ask about, put it here first.

fields.name: attest_accurate
fields.label: The revenue and customer figures above are actuals, not projections.

fields.name: attest_share
fields.label: I understand that Foundry for Good will share this application with the Pitch Forum panel.
